status: PROPOSAL — staged. Locked CCODE-64 schema; dice final for their tier; SNG-264 §3 bound classes.
note: SNG-263 catalog pass, tradition 10 of 27 — UMBRAL, completing the DARK/LIGHT axis with blazeborn (the pilot). THE PAIR'S SIGNATURE, consistent with the other three axes: blazeborn's lightsense reads what light SAYS and 'darkness stays genuinely opaque (the gap the Umbrals built an art inside)'; umbral's darksight 'sees the dark, NOT THE INTENT moving in it'. Each names the other's country. But this pair has something the others don't — umbral's crafts are morally weighted toward RESPONSIBILITY: nearly every bound is about what you owe for what you hide.

boundClasses.soft: a limit of SKILL — sustained mastery erodes it
boundClasses.hard: a limit of WHAT THE CRAFT IS — no mastery ever reaches it
boundClasses.cost: the price stays but its FORM changes with mastery

rankDeltas.delta: see FAR AND FINE without light — read a face across a black room, follow a trail BY THE SHAPE OF THE AIR IN IT
SPECIAL: the dark becomes your NATIVE MEDIUM — you see better in it than most see at noon, and you can CHOOSE light-blindness and shed it at will

intensity.conserve: a dark-adjusted glance — half the range, and light does not hurt as much
intensity.surge: double the sight; SUDDEN LIGHT STILL BLINDS YOU

bounds.text: TOTAL LIGHT DEFEATS IT — sees dark, not hidden intent
SUDDEN LIGHT STILL BLINDS YOU
you see the DARK, NOT THE INTENT MOVING IN IT
A LIFE SPENT IN THE DARK MARKS YOU — Blazeborn read it on sight

crafts.designNote: Exact antipode to blazeborn's lightsense — and both name the other's blind spot in the same terms. lightsense: 'darkness stays genuinely opaque (THE GAP THE UMBRALS BUILT AN ART INSIDE)'. darksight: 'you see the dark, NOT THE INTENT moving in it'. FIFTH antipode pair, fifth time the T-I senses carry the geometry. The pattern is now unbroken across every axis authored.

mechanic.note: incapacitating rung — it suppresses LIGHT, including other people's light-craft

rankDeltas.delta: dim a WHOLE PLACE — a hall, a street, a courtyard — down to working shadow, and HOLD IT THERE

intensity.conserve: a deeper shadow — half the dimming, and it costs nothing to hold
intensity.surge: double the dark; HOLDING COSTS CONTINUOUSLY and a determined light-worker pushes back

bounds.text: brief at r1; BRIGHT OPEN GROUND DEFEATS IT
YOU CANNOT DOUSE THE SUN, AND YOU CANNOT DOUSE THE BLAZE
holding costs CONTINUOUSLY — a determined light-worker can push back

crafts.designNote: SIXTH cross-tradition counter, and the most direct yet: dim r2 puts out 'a Radiant's kindled beam MID-BURN' — a craft that counters another tradition's craft WHILE IT IS BEING CAST. But its own HARD bound concedes the limit: 'you cannot douse the Blaze.' It beats radiant's kindle, not blazeborn's radiance. Ranked counters again, exactly like lance/shield.

rankDeltas.delta: DRAW SUSTENANCE from genuine lightlessness — reduced need for warmth, light, and ordinary comforts in true dark
SPECIAL: in the lightless depths WHERE OTHERS RUN OUT, YOU RUN DEEPER — the dark is not deprivation, it is where you are most alive

intensity.conserve: settle into it — half the relief, and it asks nothing
intensity.surge: double it; you are drawing on a place most people cannot follow you into

bounds.text: REQUIRES GENUINE LIGHTLESSNESS — a dim room is not the dark

crafts.designNote: Exact antipode to blazeborn's the_radiant_ground ('requires INTENSE light — worthless in shade'). Two T-I sustain crafts, each useless in the other's medium. The fairness-by-geometry pattern from lattice/churnfolk (catch_as_catch_can 'requires DISORDER') repeats on a third axis.

rankDeltas.delta: hide a person, a truth, or a thing SO WELL EVEN A SEARCHER WHO KNOWS IT IS THERE CANNOT FIND IT; move unseen through watched places
COMMAND SHADOW AT SCALE — hide a caravan, a rite, A REBELLION; see into the hidden hearts of things; GIVE SANCTUARY

bounds.text: TOTAL LIGHT DEFEATS IT

mechanic.note: A GUARD SHAPE WITH ZERO SOAK — deliberate. Its own bound: 'concealment hides, it does not defend.' The Harbor protects by never being found, not by absorbing a blow. If it IS found, it offers nothing.

rankDeltas.delta: harbor so completely that A SEARCHER WHO KNOWS IT IS THERE STILL COMES AWAY EMPTY

rankDeltas.from: r3 grants — a sanctuary others can enter is a kind-change

intensity.conserve: hide one thing — half the concealment, and you answer for less
intensity.surge: double the harbor; EVERYONE INSIDE BECOMES YOUR RESPONSIBILITY, INCLUDING THE ONES YOU WOULD NOT HAVE CHOSEN

bounds.text: YOU BECOME RESPONSIBLE FOR WHAT YOU HARBOR
THE BLAZE CAN STILL BURN what it cannot see
the harbored thing is NOW YOURS TO ANSWER FOR
EVERYONE INSIDE BECOMES YOUR RESPONSIBILITY, INCLUDING THE ONES YOU WOULD NOT HAVE CHOSEN

crafts.designNote: A FIFTH DEFENSIVE LOGIC, and mechanically the strangest: soak 0. It defends by NOT BEING FOUND. BLUNT / ANCHOR / EVADE / RUN-WITHOUT-YOU / NEVER-FOUND. bounds.text: bright light THINS it; a knowing searcher with a lamp can work at it

WHAT YOU SHROUD AND FORGET, YOU MAY NEVER FIND AGAIN

mechanic.note: CONDITIONAL healing — it works BETTER in true darkness. The +1 assumes the condition is met; in light it is worse than an ordinary mend.

rankDeltas.delta: in TRUE SHADOW recovery proceeds with unusual speed — fever breaks faster, pain quiets, wounds close cleaner than they should
SPECIAL: set a person in genuine lightlessness and healing proceeds PAST THE ORDINARY — as if darkness itself were medicine

intensity.surge: double it; the patient must be kept in genuine lightlessness, which is its own hardship

crafts.designNote: The exact inverse of radiant's dawn_surgery (heals by BURNING CLEAN in full light) and rootkin's set_to_rights (heals by RESTORING THE DESIGN). THREE healing crafts, three incompatible theories of medicine — light, design, and darkness. The `healing` shape carries all three through magnitudes and bounds alone.

rankDeltas.delta: step between shadows ACROSS A ROOM, A STREET, A BATTLEFIELD — anywhere dark touches dark

bounds.text: BOTH ENDS NEED REAL SHADOW — a lit gap is a WALL
TOTAL LIGHT STRANDS YOU
THE SHADOWROAD IS NOT EMPTY. SOMETHING ELSE USES IT.

crafts.designNote: FOURTH travel craft with terrain-exclusive access, and the pattern is now complete across four axes: the_root_road (life, cannot cross the dead or the made) · the_grey_road (death, needs death substantial and recent) · shortfold (mechanism, both ends must be KNOWN) · shadowstep (dark, both ends need real shadow, LIGHT IS A WALL). Every axis's travel craft is walled off by its antipode's medium. CCODE: terrain-gated movement is a real mechanic the catalog assumes and the engine does not have.

rankDeltas.delta: TRANSFORM A SPACE'S LIGHT CONDITIONS and give shadow the shape you need — it holds until you release it or something breaks it

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: move through THE MOST-WATCHED PLACE leaving NO TRACE, NO MEMORY, NO EVIDENCE you were ever there. The capstone is a KIND (unbeing-in-the-record) at near-total cost.

passFindings: THE DARK/LIGHT AXIS IS NOW COMPLETE (blazeborn was the pilot; radiant is its foothill; umbral is the antipode) and the T-I sense pattern holds a FIFTH time: lightsense 'darkness stays genuinely opaque — THE GAP THE UMBRALS BUILT AN ART INSIDE' vs darksight 'you see the dark, NOT THE INTENT MOVING IN IT'. Five axes, five times the two T-I senses carry the geometry. Unbroken.

A FIFTH DEFENSIVE LOGIC, mechanically the strangest: the_harbor is a GUARD with soak 0. It defends by NOT BEING FOUND — its own bound says 'concealment hides, it does not defend', and if it IS found it offers nothing. BLUNT / ANCHOR / EVADE / RUN-WITHOUT-YOU / NEVER-FOUND. CCODE: this needs a zero-soak concealment defence whose failure mode is TOTAL, a genuinely different curve from soak that degrades.

TERRAIN-GATED MOVEMENT IS NOW A COMPLETE PATTERN ACROSS FOUR AXES, and the engine has no concept of it: the_root_road (cannot cross the dead or the made) · the_grey_road (death substantial and recent) · shortfold (both ends must be truly known) · shadowstep (both ends need real shadow — A LIT GAP IS A WALL). Every axis's travel craft is walled off by its antipode's medium. Adding to the open-checks list.

dim r2 puts out 'a Radiant's kindled beam MID-BURN' — a craft that counters another tradition's craft WHILE IT IS BEING CAST, and the sixth cross-tradition counter found. But its own HARD bound concedes the limit: 'you cannot douse the Blaze.' It beats radiant's kindle, not blazeborn's radiance — RANKED counters again, exactly like lance/shield.

THREE HEALING CRAFTS, THREE INCOMPATIBLE THEORIES OF MEDICINE: radiant's dawn_surgery heals by BURNING CLEAN in full light; rootkin's set_to_rights by RESTORING THE DESIGN; umbral's the_shadowed_mending by DARKNESS AS MEDICINE (and it is merely competent in light). The one `healing` shape carries all three through magnitudes and bounds alone — further evidence the schema generalises.

UMBRAL'S MORAL SIGNATURE IS RESPONSIBILITY, and it is unique in the catalog: nearly every bound is about what you OWE for what you hide. 'Harboring something makes you responsible for it' · 'the harbored thing is now yours to answer for' · 'everyone inside becomes your responsibility, INCLUDING THE ONES YOU WOULD NOT HAVE CHOSEN' · 'what waits at the end of a trail you invented is not yours to choose'. Where other traditions bound POWER, umbral bounds CONSEQUENCE.

the_never_there's bound names the NEXT tradition as its counter: 'a Verity-reader may feel THE ABSENCE ITSELF' — the truth-tradition detects the umbral capstone not by seeing through it but by noticing a hole in the record. A direct hook into the veilwright/verist pair.
